why: Neither proposal delivers the mustard velvet sofa or ceramic pots. A's warm cognac sofa, large rust-and-blue patterned rug, and warm wood-and-brass pieces create a cohesive, lively boho look that suits the warm parquet. B's black velvet sofa, gray kilim, and gray plaid throw read dark and muted, against the cheerful, colorful feel the client asked for.
